about: Rigid corrections applied to fetched Poly Haven props by tools/fix_props.py (S36 asset follow-up, 2026-10-19). Each fixes a C-3 or C-4 finding of `cast.py contact-items`; the gate stays the judge.

outdoor_table_chair_set_01.why: C-3: all four feet of the chair sat 5.9 mm under the floor the table stands on (the table's feet are at y = 0). Lifted onto it.
C-3: the same 5.9 mm as chair_01.

wooden_crate_01.why: C-3: the origin sat 7.9 mm above the underside of the crate's bottom boards. The whole prop (box, lid, latch) is lifted so the boards rest on y = 0.

wall_clock.why: C-4: the second hand's hub (z 25.2-31.3 mm) was modelled straight through the hour (z 28) and minute (z 29) hands. On a movement the second hand is the outermost; it is stacked in front of the minute hand (hub from z 29.5), still behind the glass (z 35.3).

modern_ceiling_lamp_01.why: C-4: the bulb's top was 4.6 mm up inside the metal socket. Lowered 3.5 mm: it stays seated about 1 mm, so no gap shows.

street_lamp_01.why: C-4: the bulb's base was 4.1 mm down inside its socket. Raised 3.5 mm: it stays seated, so no gap shows.

C-4: the four panes ran 5.6 mm into the corner posts and rails, where a real lantern has a groove. The pane edges inside the frame are cut away, so each pane ends at the frame (0.3 mm clear); shrinking the panes instead opened visible slivers of light.

street_lamp_02.why: C-4: the same 4.1 mm bulb-in-socket overlap as street_lamp_01.
C-4: street_lamp_01's lantern head and the same 5.6 mm pane-in-frame overlap; the same cut.

hanging_industrial_lamp.why: C-4: the bulb holder ran 12 mm through the glass cover's top disc, which was modelled without a hole, and the glass passed through the clips that hold it. The glass inside the metal is cut away: the disc gets the holder's hole, the rim ends at each clip.

potted_plant_02.why: C-4: the stems ran 7.7 mm through the soil clods. The soil is cut where a stem passes, as soil parts around a real stem; the stems are closed tubes, so they are the cutter.
C-4: the soil's edge ran 10.5 mm into the pot wall under its inward-curving lip. The soil inside the wall is cut away, so it ends at the wall.
